message.quirky.totem_spawned: Your holding totem spawned in %s at (%s, %s, %s) — %s blocks from your spawn point
message.quirky.totem_spawned_cross: Your holding totem spawned in %s at (%s, %s, %s) — not in the same dimension as your spawn point
text.autoconfig.quirky.title: Quirky Config
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.mapPreview: Show a live map preview when hovering a map in your inventory.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.harvestRep: Right-click fully grown crops to harvest and replant them in one go.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.doubleDoor: Opening one door also opens the matching door next to it.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.clockToolt: Show the day and time when hovering a clock.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.cloudBottl: Use a glass bottle on a cloud block to collect it into a bottle.
Right-click armor in a container to equip it directly, or swap it with the piece you are wearing.
Eating a melon slice spits out its seeds.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.totemOfHol: Keep your inventory on death; a holding totem spawns where you died and drops your items when hit.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitsToRetr: How many hits the holding totem needs before it drops its contents.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.spawnHeigh: How many blocks above the death point the holding totem spawns. 1 keeps it in reach; 2 raises it one block higher.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitSoundVo: Volume of the sound when the totem is hit. Values above 1 only extend the falloff distance; loudness is capped at 1.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitSoundPi: Pitch of the sound when the totem is hit.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.retrieveSo: Volume of the sound when the totem's contents are retrieved.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.enchantPar: 1 in N chance per tick to spawn a purple rune particle; higher values make particles rarer.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.endRodPart: 1 in N chance per tick to spawn a white light particle; higher values make particles rarer.
Horizontal spread radius (blocks) of the white light particles.
Vertical spread height (blocks) of the white light particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.particleXz: Horizontal spread radius (blocks) of the purple rune particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.particleYS: Vertical spread height (blocks) of the purple rune particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.modelScale: Display scale of the holding totem model.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.bobAmplitu: How far the totem floats up and down (blocks).
Floating period in ticks; higher values bob slower.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.spinPeriod: Rotation period in ticks; higher values spin slower.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.swayPeriod: Sway period in ticks; higher values sway slower.
